description.value: Rockwater Secret Cove Resort is a luxury coastal retreat perched above the Pacific near Halfmoon Bay on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering iconic suspended Tenthouse Suites, renovated Oceanview Cabins, and lodge rooms — all with uninterrupted ocean views. The resort features an on-site oceanfront restaurant (TuBird), a spa, and complimentary kayak rentals exclusively for resort guests. It is a distinctive destination property for cyclists seeking upscale accommodation while touring the Sunshine Coast.

address.value: 5356 Oles Cove Rd, Halfmoon Bay, BC V7Z 1B8
